publishable: only after complete evidence and audit; no automatic result promotion
selection_source: final_resolution_20261020/decision.json after all27new screening runs; D>C>B>A frozen priority
A_definition: v2 arm1 ordinary continuous decoder; formal matched-protocol retraining, not development validation predictions
training_recipe: inherit final-resolution screening recipe and exact v2 checkpoint rule; no post-screen tuning
checkpoint: validation only; harmonic(max(0,M1)*matched coverage,waveform_R_F1); earliest strict-best; first10epochs no patience; patience15; max100

test_policy.access: only after training terminates and best checkpoint is frozen
test_policy.failure: record and stop for audit; never silently retry a completed test evaluation

metrics: frozen M1/coverage/product, M2/M3, strict beat PCC, record-optimal PCC, regional QRS/T PCC, amplitude ratio, RMSE, event-head MAE and R-F1, waveform R-F1; identical for all compared models

statistics.comparison: selected main versus A on held-out test subjects; no self-comparison if winner A
statistics.unit: subject, datasets separate; never folds-times-seeds as independent samples
statistics.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean within subject across42/43/44 for main; A seed42 directly; average M1-times-coverage products, not product of seed averages
statistics.paired_difference: main minus A in original metric units; negative favors main for error metrics
statistics.wilcoxon: two-sided paired signed-rank, zero_method=wilcox, method=auto; all-zero differences yield p=1; report nonzero n
statistics.effect: median of within-subject paired differences, not difference of group medians
statistics.bootstrap: paired subject resampling with replacement,10000replicates,percentile2.5/97.5CI of median paired difference
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across the two primary endpoint p-values separately within each dataset; report raw and adjusted p; remaining metrics descriptive/exploratory
statistics.missingness: report missing subjects/counts; no imputation or silent exclusion; incomplete primary endpoint precludes complete-confirmation claim

execution_order: implement and preflight registered formal runner with test-access state machine
